title: Brand page: 83 white fills bound, section stroke bound, #444 gap filed
summary: All 83 raw #ffffff fill nodes in Section 1:61 (Tenure / Brand and surfaces) have been visually disambiguated and bound to canonical Colour variables. 70 nodes bound to paper-warm (elevated panels, Console windows, swatch tiles, type-ramp rows, tier grid, timeline events, card-row container); 13 nodes bound to paper (recessed roles-list sub-panels × 3 and 19 role rows × 1 = roles lists inside agent cards bound to paper as recessed interior structure; queue header + 6 queue rows in Joiner; queue panel + 8 rows in Mover; case file panel + 6 case rows in Leaver). Section 1:61 stroke rebound from #ffffff to paper-rule. The single #444444 fill is the Section canvas backdrop — no Stratum token covers a neutral mid-dark section backdrop; surfaced as new token gap 'section-backdrop' requiring Chairman ratification before binding. All AAA contrast pairs confirmed clear at or above 7:1 after rebinding; lowest is ochre-link on paper at 7.14:1.

new_token_gap.name: Tenure (Section)
new_token_gap.description: Section canvas backdrop. #444444 is a neutral mid-dark grey with no equivalent in the Stratum Colour token set. Closest candidates are ink (#0e1626, too dark/navy) and ink-3 (#4b5365, too purple-slate). A dedicated 'backdrop' or 'canvas-dark' token at approximately #3a3a3a–#505050 is needed for brand-display sections that use a dark staging backdrop. Requires Chairman ratification. Do not force-bind to ink-2 (#2a3344) — the visual shift from neutral grey to navy is a design-register change, not a token substitution.
